description.ja: 主を片隅や片側に寄せて広く空ける
description.en: Push the focal thing to one side and leave wide space

description.ja: 全面に均して中心を消す
description.en: Spread evenly and erase the center
Divide the field with a line
A flock and one that strays

description.ja: 主・従・添えの不等辺の三角
description.en: An unequal triangle of focal, secondary and accent

summary.ja: 画面の辺を 0.382 : 0.618 で分ける線と、その 4 つの交点に、主な物と線を置く。
summary.en: Place the main things and lines on the lines that divide the canvas's sides 0.382 : 0.618 and on their four crossings.

summary.ja: 辺を 1 : √2 で分ける線（0.414・0.586）と交点に置く。
summary.en: Place on the lines that divide the sides 1 : √2 (0.414 and 0.586) and on their crossings.

summary.ja: 辺を三つに分ける線（1/3・2/3）と交点に置く。
summary.en: Place on the lines that divide the sides in three (1/3 and 2/3) and on their crossings.

summary.ja: 辺を音の協和の比 2:3（0.4・0.6）か 3:4（0.429・0.571）で分ける線と交点に置く。
summary.en: Place on the lines that divide the sides by a consonant ratio of sound, 2:3 (0.4 and 0.6) or 3:4 (0.429 and 0.571), and on their crossings.

summary.ja: 画面の対角線・中心の縦の線・中心の横の線を骨組みにして、線の物と、いくつかの形を並べた物を、その上に置く。
summary.en: Take the canvas's diagonals, its central vertical line and its central horizontal line as the armature, and place line things and things of several shapes in a row on them.

summary.ja: 基準の物を一つ選び、従と添えの物の大きさを、基準を 1 として 0.618・0.382 にする。
summary.en: Choose one base thing; the secondary and accent things are 0.618 and 0.382 of the base's size.

summary.ja: 大きな相手は中心寄りに、小さな物は中心をはさんだ反対側の遠くに置き、重さ×距離を釣り合わせる。
summary.en: Keep a large partner near the center and place a small thing far away on the other side of the center, balancing weight × distance.

summary.ja: 中心線に対して対に置く。物の中心を軸に置き、二つでなる物は軸の両側に鏡に置く。
summary.en: Place in pairs about a central line. The thing's center goes on the axis, and a thing of two parts is mirrored on either side of it.

summary.ja: 同じ形を同じ間隔で並べる。
summary.en: Repeat the same shape at equal intervals.

summary.ja: 物の形を一つずつの列にし、大きさか間隔を、隣どうし同じ比で変える。
summary.en: Line the thing's shapes up one by one and change their size or their spacing by the same ratio between neighbours.

summary.ja: 物の形を 2・3・4 個ずつの群にして、群の間に間をおいて列に並べる。
summary.en: Group the thing's shapes by 2, 3 or 4 and line them up with a rest between the groups.

summary.ja: 遠くの物を、地との明るさの差が小さい寒色か灰に替え、小さくする。
summary.en: Turn distant things to the cool color or gray closest to the ground in lightness and make them smaller.

summary.ja: 法則が位置・間隔・大きさ・色を決め、手の揺らぎはその規則を壊さない幅に収める。主の法則にはしない。
summary.en: The laws decide places, spacing, sizes and colors, and the hand's sway stays within what keeps their rules. Never the main law.

summary.ja: 画面の中に、物が隙間なく詰まる密の所を一つ作り、ほかを大きく空ける。
summary.en: Make one dense place in the picture where things crowd without a gap, and leave the rest wide open.

summary.ja: 一つの単位の形を、規則で敷き詰める（青海波・七宝・市松・鱗・亀甲）。
summary.en: Tile the canvas with one unit shape by a rule (seigaiha, shippo, ichimatsu, uroko, kikko).

summary.ja: 二つの声部を、同じ長さに違う数で等間隔に並べて重ねる。
summary.en: Lay two voices over each other, each lined up at equal spacing along the same length with a different count.

summary.ja: 一つの形（動機）を、大きさ・向き・鏡映・ずらした重ねを順に変えながら繰り返す。
summary.en: Repeat one shape (the motif), changing its size, its turn, its mirror image and a staggered overlap in turn.

summary.ja: 一つの流れを三段にする。まばら→変化→密になる。
summary.en: Make one flow in three stages: from sparse to changing to dense.

summary.ja: 同じ形を、厳格（真）・半ば崩す（行）・自在（草）の三つの度合いで描き分ける。
summary.en: Draw the same shape in three degrees: strict (shin), half loosened (gyo) and free (so).

name.ja: 補色の対比・同時対比
黄金分割・左上の交点
黄金分割・右上の交点
黄金分割・左下の交点
黄金分割・右下の交点

name.en: Rule of thirds, left vertical line
Rule of thirds, right vertical line
Rule of thirds, upper horizontal line
Rule of thirds, lower horizontal line
